takeaways: Enterprise systems built as systems of record force people to act as manual integration layers; agents that observe events, reason over business data and orchestrate actions turn them into systems of action.

Dynamics 365 agents are useful because they are grounded in Dataverse and inherit the same security roles, row-level security, DLP policies, approval workflows and audit trails as the users they work for.

Start with one high-volume, painful process, clean the underlying data first, govern agents through Agent 365 with sponsors and approvals, and prepare people to supervise agents and handle exceptions.
hook: Sales reps, controllers and buyers still spend hours copying data between email, CRM and ERP. This episode is for business and IT leaders working with Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform, and it explains how Dataverse-grounded agents take over data entry, reconciliation and routing while staying inside your security and governance rules.
